sentences.text: Exception handling preserves a traceable hold state until the source of a discrepancy is understood and the affected pallet can be safely routed.
A mismatch between expected and observed pallet attributes prevents automatic allocation and directs the load to controlled review.
The operating record retains the scan result, location, and time of detection so that the review can be reconstructed.
Cinderbay consumes its inspection-stage advisory and records whether the pallet can proceed, requires rework, or must remain held.
A held pallet remains separated from available stock until the review outcome is entered and validated.
Inbound Pallet Buffer provides temporary staging without implying that a held load has been accepted into inventory.
North Aisle Stacker Crane uses the Slot Reservation Receipt to confirm that its assigned destination remains reserved.
Before movement, the crane checks its current task state and stops if the destination or access path is no longer valid.
Morrowglass, the Warehouse Management System, consumes the load advisory to apply the required handling constraints to affected work.
The system prevents an incompatible allocation from being released while the advisory remains applicable.
If a task is blocked, the control record identifies the hold reason and retains the pallet's last confirmed location.
Warehouse Operations Supervisor reviews unresolved holds and assigns an escalation when the operating team cannot clear them locally.
The supervisor also confirms that a delayed task will not compromise a later outbound wave or an aisle access limit.
Service readiness requires a recorded fault state, a controlled work area, and a clear separation between maintenance activity and live movement.
North Aisle Stacker Crane reports a fault that could affect positioning, load retention, braking, or travel before the equipment is returned to service.
The affected crane remains unavailable while personnel inspect the fault and verify that adjacent equipment can continue safely.
Maintenance Release Terminal records the inspection outcome and the identity of the person authorizing a return to operation.
A failed test keeps the equipment inhibited and returns the fault to the maintenance queue for further diagnosis.
A successful test does not by itself release the crane until required interlocks and operating limits have been checked.
Outbound Checkweigh Scale produces the Gross Weight Variance Slip when a measured pallet weight falls outside the configured tolerance.
The variance remains unresolved until the pallet is reweighed or the documented review establishes a safe disposition.
Conveyor Line Controller holds affected transfers when an exception would make the next movement uncertain.
Fire Alarm Panel and Safety Zone Controller retain authority to stop or restrict movement whenever their safety status requires it.
Warehouse Operations Supervisor releases normal work only after outstanding exceptions, maintenance holds, and access constraints have been reconciled.
